Научи ИИ — third-party software and model attribution

TensorFlow.js 4.22.0
Copyright Google LLC and TensorFlow.js contributors.
License: Apache License 2.0; full text: ./vendor/LICENSE-APACHE-2.0.txt
Source: https://github.com/tensorflow/tfjs
Distribution: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@tensorflow/tfjs@4.22.0/dist/tf.min.js

MobileNet v1, width multiplier 0.50, input 224 x 224
Pretrained on ImageNet; distributed by the TensorFlow.js project.
Copyright Google Inc. / Google LLC and contributors.
License: Apache License 2.0; full text: ./vendor/LICENSE-APACHE-2.0.txt
Model and weight source:
https://storage.googleapis.com/tfjs-models/tfjs/mobilenet_v1_0.50_224/model.json
Reference: https://github.com/tensorflow/tfjs-examples/tree/master/webcam-transfer-learning
Original research: https://arxiv.org/abs/1704.04861

The original model weights are unchanged. The application uses the
conv_pw_13_relu activations and spatial average pooling to produce 512
features, followed by a separate cosine-similarity kNN classifier.
No ImageNet training images are included.

Local asset checksums are in ./asset-hashes.json.
